conservative.requirements: 9 power, target living creature within medium range Special: You can cast Lamehk’s Dominion against multiple targets. For each target beyond the first, add 1 to the check.

success.description: A Calling upon Lamehk’s the Slavemaster of the Third Hell, the wizard takes control of the foe’s thoughts. The target immediately performs one of his available actions of your choice. You make all the relevant decisions for the target, such as who to target or how to spend boons. You can’t force the target to spend fortune, or suffer fatigue, stress, or wounds as part of the requirements of playing the action, nor do something obviously suicidal.
As above, and you can also force the target to perform a single manoeuvre. Place 1 fewer recharge token on this card.

sigmarsComet.description: On your next turn, the target must again perform the action of your choice, as above. Place 2 recharge tokens on this card.
